mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of a rising federal funds rate and declining unemployment rate indicates a strong economy with tightening monetary policy, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a sustained decline in unemployment signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 6.0% and UNRATE declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.6 million units per month and rise by more than 5% in a single month, it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1600.0 and HOUST rises > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of rising housing starts (HOUST) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a supply-constrained economy with strong demand, increasing inflation expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-demand regime (RSAFS < 500000.0 million dollars), a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a recovery in consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS < 500000.0 and RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
